newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk-Israeli naval exercises likely in October.
newsitem.headline: Turk-Israeli naval exercises likely in October.

text.p: A joint operation by Turkish and Israeli naval forces in the eastern Mediterranean is expected to take place in October, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Friday.

The agency cited diplomatic sources as saying the naval exercises, in which the United States is also expected to participate, would have a humanitarian character and be open to other countries in the region.
The planned manoeuvres have alarmed Arab states, already angered over military cooperation between NATO member Turkey and Israel.
Ankara has signed two military accords with Israel allowing Israeli jets to use Turkish airspace for training flights and to upgrade its own F-4 fighters in Israel.
